coverage.finding: The folio number '132' with a superscript 'b' is at top left, about native x370-500, y310-430. It is correctly recorded in r001.

A single ink line runs at about native x1724-2634, y4205-4285. It reads 'ff.1-18, closely rel[..]t[.] to 1-0. 4823', with 'related to' highly cursive. The character between the I/1 and the O looks more like a hyphen than a full stop. No cancellation is visible. There is no second line and no interlinear addition.

An ink arrow '←' sits at about native x3019-3094, y4215-4250, on the target side of the gutter (gutter at x≈3140). It is properly treated as part of r002's apparatus. The matching dash at about x3199-3294 is on facing fol. 133 and is not a target block.

changes.reason: In the native tile, the mark between the initial upright ('I', written like '1') and the 'O' is a short horizontal stroke, which looks hyphen-like rather than a dot. The written form is kept, and the alternative reading stays flagged rather than resolved.

before.evidence: The arrow and dash align across the gutter with the d. 149 entries on fol. 133. The d. 149(7) entry there reads 'ff.1-16, ⟦closely⟧ ... recension of preceding', which suggests a related annotation. Which of the two entries is meant cannot be fixed from layout alone.

after.evidence: In the fol. 133 context image, the '← —' sits level with the line of 'Vd. 149(6)', which is the first of the two entries. On the content side, the next line, d. 149(7), has an extent 'ff.1-1[6?]' and a cancelled 'closely' followed by a recension remark. That content would suit a replacement note of this kind. Layout favours (6) and content favours (7), so the attachment is not resolved.

changes.reason: Layout evidence from the context image shows the dash level with d. 149(6). The candidate's wording did not distinguish the conflicting layout evidence from the content evidence.

unresolved.issue: Two attachment targets remain possible on fol. 133: d. 149(6), favoured by alignment, and d. 149(7), favoured by content and the cancelled 'closely'. The extent '18' versus the facing '16' is also not reconciled.

unresolved.issue: The words 'related to' are cursive and only tentatively read. The separator in 'I-O.'/'I.O.' is ambiguous.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with other occurrences of 'I.O.' in this hand.
